primaryKeyword.zh-CN: Canvas 指纹检测：哈希变化、稳定性与读回异常怎么判断

rows.intent: Tool and diagnostic explanation. Users want a live result and to interpret stability or spoof warnings.
rows.gap: BrowserLeaks explains the drawing/hash method and population sample; WebBrowserTools emphasizes persistent/random noise detection. Neither replaces a controlled profile lifecycle record.
rows.informationGain: A same-input four-run worksheet for baseline, refresh, restart and profile B, distinguishing rendering changes, blocked reads and privacy defenses without treating one hash as personal identity.
rows.demandEvidence: Actual public SERP query and selected result-body review; not first-party queries or measured search volume

primaryKeyword.zh-CN: WebGL 指纹检测：Renderer、ANGLE 与图像哈希怎么读

rows.intent: Inspect GPU/rendering report and explain abnormal or missing renderer fields.
rows.gap: BrowserLeaks exposes many parameters; WebBrowserTools provides image/noise tests. Large field dumps need a decision process for masked versus unmasked fields and expected implementation differences.
rows.informationGain: A field-to-action table for context/version/vendor/renderer/extensions/image hash and controlled hardware-acceleration observations, separating software/ANGLE layers from claimed physical GPU.
rows.demandEvidence: Actual public SERP query and selected result-body review; not first-party queries or measured search volume

primaryKeyword.zh-CN: 浏览器时区与语言检测：偏移、夏令时和请求头一致性

rows.intent: Diagnose disagreement across IP geolocation, browser locale and date/time formatting.
rows.gap: TrustMyIP provides direct mismatch guidance and mabl explains legitimate locale/timezone testing. Broad match/mismatch labels can hide travel, multilingual users, DST and IP location uncertainty.
rows.informationGain: A layered observation sheet for IANA zone, date-specific offset, navigator languages and Accept-Language with legitimate disagreement cases and minimal-change retest.
rows.demandEvidence: Actual public SERP query and selected result-body review; not first-party queries or measured search volume

primaryKeyword.zh-CN: 浏览器代理 DNS 泄漏检测：解析器结果与真实路径边界

rows.gap: Results focus on tools and resolver locations. Browser-triggered authoritative observation is often conflated with packet-level proof or complete anonymity.
rows.informationGain: Separate observed recursive resolvers from browser/system/proxy resolution paths; use baseline/retest and explain DoH, anycast, IPv6 and inconclusive tests.
rows.demandEvidence: Actual public SERP query and selected result-body review; not first-party queries or measured search volume
